title: Merge liburing with debian unstable, version 0.7-3.
commit_message:
Merge liburing with debian unstable, version 0.7-3.

There are updates to the test-related patches: now
more tests pass with 0.7-3 (than 0.6-3) on Hirsute.

Autopkgtests PASS on amd64/arm64/ppc64el/s390x but
not on riscv64 (it doesn't run tests at the moment)
nor on armhf (but it isn't a regression; the exact
same issues happen on 0.6-3ubuntu1 as well.)

Note that the disable test set for s390x is larger
(see d/p/disable-known-failures.patch), because it
is the only arch hitting bind() assertion failures,
but this is not a regression either, it happens on
0.6.3-ubuntu1; and some new tests just hit it too.

diff --git a/debian/patches/disable-known-failures.patch b/debian/patches/disable-known-failures.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ad5baa1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/disable-known-failures.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+Description: disable known test failures
+ With the tests always failing they are worth nothing.
+ Upstream has post 0.6 many test improvements/additions/fixes
+ but while the situation will change not all will be resolved.
+ .
+ To make our testing worth the time let us disable the tests
+ we know to fail in the test environment.
+ .
+ We don't want the source or examples or anything in the binary
+ packages to carry this modification. Instead just patch this
+ before the tests run.
+ .
+ Implementing this as a patch also will force us to re-evalaute
+ this every release that modifies the test list as it won't apply
+ then and thereby break the test.
+ .
+ UPDATE: 2021-02-01: mfo: simplify patch from modifying the list
+ 'all_targets' to filter-out it based on the 'skip_targets' list
+ for 0.7-3 as most tests are passing (poll-many fails everywhere,
+ and s390x has assertion failures on bind() in 0.6-3ubuntu1 plus
+ on new tests added in 0.7-3; sometimes fadvise fails.)
+Forwarded: not-needed (Test environment specific)
+Author: Christian Ehrhardt <christian.ehrhardt@canonical.com>
+Author: Mauricio Faria de Oliveira <mfo@canonical.com>
+Last-Update: 2021-02-01
+
+From 646bdd5553483bbfed279b4b583bf9bbd3d9cf4e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Christian Ehrhardt <christian.ehrhardt@canonical.com>
+Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2020 15:25:33 +0200
+Subject: [PATCH] test/Makefile: disable known failing tests
+
+Signed-off-by: Christian Ehrhardt <christian.ehrhardt@canonical.com>
+---
+ test/Makefile | 28 ++++++++++++----------------
+ 1 file changed, 12 insertions(+), 16 deletions(-)
+
+Index: liburing/test/Makefile
+===================================================================
+--- liburing.orig/test/Makefile
++++ liburing/test/Makefile
+@@ -41,6 +41,13 @@ ifdef CONFIG_HAVE_CXX
+ all_targets += sq-full-cpp
+ endif
+ 
++skip_targets = poll-many fadvise
++ifeq ($(shell uname -m),s390x)
++# Assertion `bind(<skfd>, (struct sockaddr *) &addr, sizeof(addr)) != -1' failed.
++skip_targets += 232c93d07b74-test socket-rw accept poll-link connect
++endif
++all_targets := $(filter-out $(skip_targets),$(all_targets))
++
+ all: $(all_targets)
+ 
+ %: %.c
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b5f3749
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+disable-known-failures.patch
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index afea741..068c04d 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -33,4 +33,16 @@ override_dh_auto_build:
 # XXX: The tests do not pass yet on Linux 5.5, and they are not being
 # skipped either.
 override_dh_auto_test:
-	dh_auto_test -- runtests || true
+ifeq (,$(findstring nocheck,$(DEB_BUILD_OPTIONS)))
+ ifeq ($(DEB_RULES_REQUIRES_ROOT),dpkg/target-subcommand)
+  ifeq (,$(findstring fakeroot,$(DEB_GAIN_ROOT_CMD)))
+	$(DEB_GAIN_ROOT_CMD) dh_auto_test -- runtests || true
+  else
+	@echo 'Warning: Tests require real root, not fakeroot.  Skipping.' >&2
+  endif
+ else ifeq (0,$(shell id -u))
+	dh_auto_test -- runtests
+ else
+	@echo 'Warning: Tests require root.  Skipping.' >&2
+ endif
+endif
diff --git a/debian/tests/control b/debian/tests/control
index 794211a..6b93b33 100644
--- a/debian/tests/control
+++ b/debian/tests/control
@@ -6,6 +6,6 @@ Depends:
  liburing-dev,
 
 Tests: test-unit
-Restrictions: flaky rw-build-tree
+Restrictions: needs-root isolation-machine flaky rw-build-tree
 Depends:
  build-essential,
diff --git a/debian/tests/test-build b/debian/tests/test-build
old mode 100755
new mode 100644
index 5f620e8..9f2cddf
--- a/debian/tests/test-build
+++ b/debian/tests/test-build
@@ -45,6 +45,15 @@ done
 
 # Two argument tests.
 for t in io_uring-cp link-cp ucontext-cp; do
+
+  # known to fail
+  [ $t != io_uring-cp ] || continue
+
+  # known to fail in containers
+  if systemd-detect-virt --container -q; then
+    [ $t != link-cp ] || continue
+  fi
+
   ./$t $t $t.new
   cmp $t $t.new
